Why Mesquite businesses miss calls

Mesquite sits on the east side of Dallas County, where I-30 and I-635 meet, and about one in eight workers is in construction. Many local companies are family-run, with the owner working a job by day and returning calls at night. By then, a homeowner has usually hired someone else. Fast answers matter even more when customers are comparing several nearby companies from Mesquite to Garland.

Which Mesquite businesses benefit most?

  • HVAC and contractors: Catch calls from the job site and book the next visit.
  • Roofing companies: Hail days can bring more calls than one office can take.
  • Pest control: Customers who find pests want help now, not a callback tomorrow.

Can you keep your Mesquite phone number?

Yes. Mesquite callers will usually see the 214, 469, 972 and 945 area codes, and you can keep the number customers already know. Forward it to the AI for all calls, only after hours, or only when your team does not pick up. We can also set up a new local number. Everything is set up remotely, so you do not need new equipment or a visit to an office.

What to check before you go live

  1. Test real calls: ask awkward questions, not only easy ones, and listen to how it handles them.
  2. Set the rules: decide which calls transfer to a person and which become messages.
  3. Plan your minutes: estimate your busiest month, not an average one.
  4. Tell callers what you need to: Texas is generally treated as a one-party consent state for recording calls, but rules differ for callers in other states, so check with your advisor if you record calls.
